milestones.label: Buchsbaum's exact categories
milestones.work: Buchsbaum, Exact categories and duality, Transactions of the AMS, 1955
milestones.description: Buchsbaum introduces exact categories, an axiomatic setting for homological duality that Wikipedia says is the earliest form of the abelian category concept.

evidence.claim: Article record, Trans. AMS 1955

milestones.label: Cartan and Eilenberg's Homological Algebra
milestones.work: Cartan and Eilenberg, Homological Algebra, Princeton University Press, 1956
milestones.description: The first systematic monograph on homological algebra and derived functors, the textbook base for the Tohoku framework.

evidence.claim: OpenLibrary record: Princeton University Press 1956

milestones.note: The book predates Grothendieck's abelian-category axioms and treats module categories; it is counted as consolidation of homological algebra rather than of abelian categories.
